parameters.content:
## Before you run
Create a Header Auth credential named Authorization with value Bearer and your Apify token. Select it on every HTTP Request node.

Create the data table columns listed in the README, then paste that table ID into Trip settings. Leave the schedule disabled until a small manual run looks right.

The template is free. The actor charges per saved record.

const item = $input.first().json;
return [{ json: { result: 'invalid_settings', message: 'Fix the Trip settings before a run is started.', errors: item.errors || [] } }];

return [{ json: { result: 'ambiguous_start', message: 'The start request failed in n8n before a run id was saved. A run may still have been created. Check Apify before starting again. This workflow does not retry the start.' } }];

const item = $input.first().json;
return [{ json: { result: 'start_rejected', message: item.message, statusCode: item.statusCode || null } }];

const item = $input.first().json;
return [{ json: { result: 'poll_request_failed', runId: item.runId || null, message: 'The status request failed. Do not start another run until you check this run id in Apify.' } }];

const item = $input.first().json;
return [{ json: { result: 'failed', runId: item.runId, message: item.statusMessage || 'The actor run failed.', runStatus: item.runStatus } }];

const item = $input.first().json;
return [{ json: { result: 'aborted', runId: item.runId, message: item.statusMessage || 'The actor run was aborted.' } }];

const item = $input.first().json;
return [{ json: { result: 'timed_out', runId: item.runId, message: item.statusMessage || 'The actor run timed out on Apify.' } }];

const item = $input.first().json;
return [{ json: { result: 'poll_deadline', runId: item.runId, message: 'Polling stopped after ' + item.pollCount + ' checks. The actor run was not aborted and may still be charging. Open run ' + item.runId + ' in Apify.' } }];

const item = $input.first().json;
return [{ json: { result: 'unexpected_status', runId: item.runId, runStatus: item.runStatus || null, message: 'The run status was not one of the handled states. The actor was not aborted.' } }];

const item = $input.first().json;
return [{ json: { result: 'page_error', runId: item.runId, message: item.message, fetchedBeforeError: item.fetched || 0 } }];

const state = $input.first().json;
return [{ json: { result: 'empty', message: 'The actor run succeeded and returned no cars. Stored prices were not changed.', runId: state.runId, fetched: 0 } }];
